'''April 2001 Toledo tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Toledo, Ohio on 8 April 2001. [[Brad Eier]] won it. It is known from Brad Eier's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2044">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-09-here-ya-go-chester-toledo-oh-4-8-01d2044/ here-ya-go-chester-toledo-oh-4-8-01], DeckTech (brad "swccguy" eier, 9 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-09-here-ya-go-chester-toledo-oh-4-8-01d2044/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Toledo, Ohio
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 9
* '''Winner:''' [[Brad Eier]]
